## Problem
Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Reproduction
Include the command or page, minimal non-sensitive input, and steps.

## Environment
Git commit, operating system, Python/dependency versions, CPU or GPU mode, and GPU details if relevant.

## Evidence
Sanitized traceback or screenshot. Do not include tokens or private records. Use SECURITY.md for sensitive vulnerabilities.

## Research impact
Does this affect saved scores, split integrity, interpretation ratings, or only the interface?
